title: Two birch ply wardrobes either side of a chimney breast
summary: A birch ply wardrobe in each alcove of a Chiswick bedroom, with four drawers on the outer side, and the chimney breast between them faced in birch ply with shelves and wall lights.
intro: A front bedroom in Chiswick with an alcove each side of the chimney breast. The old white wardrobe and desk came out, and now each alcove has a birch ply wardrobe running up to the ceiling: a full height door by the chimney breast, and a shorter door over a column of four drawers on the outer side. Inside are hanging rails, adjustable shelves and the drawers. The chimney breast between them is faced in birch ply too, with two shelves on black hanging straps, a reading light each side over where the bed goes, and a ledge along the top of the panel that covers the old fireplace. Doors and drawers open with round finger holes, so there are no handles at all. It was drawn in 3D first, and the client picked this layout from two options.

steps.title: Back to the walls
steps.text: The old built-in wardrobe and desk came out first, so both alcoves and the chimney breast were back to bare plaster, ready to be set out.

image.alt: The bedroom with the old furniture gone: two empty alcoves and the chimney breast, the old fireplace still open

steps.title: A level base
steps.text: In each alcove a timber base frame goes down on the floorboards and is levelled first, so the wardrobe stands on something flat and true.

image.alt: A timber base frame levelled on the floorboards in the empty alcove

steps.title: Boards cut
steps.text: The birch ply cut to size and stacked in the room, sides, tops, shelves and fronts.

image.alt: Cut birch ply panels stacked against the wall

steps.title: Boxes built on the floor
steps.text: Each carcass goes together lying on the floor, squared up with clamps before it is stood up in its alcove.

image.alt: A birch ply carcass assembled on the floor, held square with clamps

steps.title: Into the alcove
steps.text: The carcass stands on its base and a birch ply lining runs up the wall beside it, so the side of the wardrobe and the alcove read as one surface.

image.alt: The first carcass standing in the alcove, with birch ply lining the wall beside it

steps.title: Scribed to the ceiling
steps.text: The edges at the top are scribed to the ceiling line, so nothing shows a gap where the old house isn't straight.

image.alt: Close up of the top of the carcass scribed tight to the ceiling

steps.title: Shelves set with the laser
steps.text: Inside, the shelves and drawer runners are set out with the laser level, so every line is level and both wardrobes match.

image.alt: Inside a carcass with red and green laser lines marking the shelf positions

steps.title: Doors and drawers
steps.text: Two doors on each wardrobe, a full height one by the chimney breast and a shorter one over a column of four drawers on the outer side.

image.alt: The left wardrobe with its doors and four drawer fronts fitted

steps.title: The chimney breast
steps.text: Between the wardrobes the chimney breast is faced in birch ply from floor to ceiling, with the wiring brought through for wall lights.

image.alt: The chimney breast faced in birch ply between the two wardrobes, wires ready for the lights

steps.title: Shelves and lights
steps.text: Two shelves on black hanging straps, a wall light each side and a ledge along the top of the lower panel.

image.alt: Two shelves on black straps over the chimney breast, beside the finished wardrobe

model3d.title: The wardrobes in 3D, as built
model3d.text: The 3D design the client chose from, brought up to date with how the job was built: no niches in the sides, a round finger hole in every door and drawer front, a ledge over a lower panel that lifts out, and the two reading lights on. Each wardrobe is 1160 mm wide and 2550 mm to the ceiling; the depth and plinth are standard sizes. Open the doors to see the insides.
